biological_support.dimension_interpretation: K2_C0002 shows a coherent, interpretable transcriptomic phenotype relative to the rest of the partition, and it is largely the mirror image of K2_C0001. The dominant down-regulated programs are oxidative phosphorylation (NES -2.29, FDR 0.001), ROS, allograft rejection, interferon alpha/gamma responses, DNA repair, mTORC1, glycolysis, IL6/JAK/STAT3, complement, MYC targets, E2F targets, and G2M checkpoint. Up-regulated programs include UV response DN (NES 1.84), WNT beta-catenin, Hedgehog, and TGF-beta signaling. The pattern is internally consistent (oxidative phosphorylation, ROS, and interferon programs share leading-edge genes such as COX/NDUF/ATP synthase subunits and interferon-stimulated genes), indicating a distinct molecular program rather than a diffuse signal.

reports.dimension_interpretation: Across the four native patient geometries, the K2_C0001–K2_C0002 boundary is only weakly represented. RNA (silhouette 0.079, negative fraction 0.282) and WXS (silhouette 0.091, negative fraction 0.262) show the clearest, though still weak, within-versus-between separation, with between-label distances modestly exceeding within-label distances. CT (silhouette 0.013, negative fraction 0.437) and WSI (silhouette 0.050, negative fraction 0.456) show near-zero separation, with between-label distances only marginally larger than within-label distances and nearly half of patients having negative silhouettes. Synthesizing jointly rather than by vote counting, the overall native-view pattern provides weak and partially conflicting evidence for the current boundary: two modalities (RNA, WXS) weakly express the boundary while two (CT, WSI) show essentially no distinction. No nearest competing set is reported for any modality.

The prior partition-level structural_diagnostics report noted weaker cross-boundary than within-set affinity on the consensus geometry; that is a partition-level screen and does not substitute for these native-geometry pair results.
